notes.title: WaggaSim V 1.0.1: Smoother Launches and More!
notes.content:
Thanks to your feedback the first WaggaSim update is here !
If you'd like to report a bug or suggest improvements, please fill out this form:
Feedback/Bug report form

Changelog:

Fixed wings shooting on launch: wings now have the correct launch velocity regardless of shape (bug #1).
Added a camera orientation indicator in the wing compass (Impr #3).
Added auto wind alignment with view button (Impr #3).
Fixed negative altitude issue when moving too far due to origin shift (bug #3).
Fixed some editor text (bug #4).


Enjoy and happy flying !
